entities.name: Network controlled inter-RAT mobility
entities.description: Mobility procedure between different radio access technologies controlled by the network. Supports mobility between NR and E-UTRA (connected to EPC or 5GC) and from NR to UTRA-FDD.

entities.name: NR
entities.description: New Radio access technology, part of 5G system.

entities.name: E-UTRA
entities.description: Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access, the LTE radio access technology.

entities.name: EPC
entities.description: Evolved Packet Core, the core network for LTE.

entities.name: 5GC
entities.description: 5G Core Network, the core network for 5G system.

entities.name: UTRA-FDD
entities.description: Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Frequency Division Duplex, the 3G radio access technology.

relations.description: Inter-RAT mobility procedure involves NR as source or target technology.
Inter-RAT mobility procedure involves E-UTRA as source or target technology.
Inter-RAT mobility procedure supports mobility from NR to UTRA-FDD.
E-UTRA can be connected to EPC core network.
E-UTRA can be connected to 5GC core network.
